channel.title: Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty (rferl.org)

item.title: Iranian Jews In Israel Hope For Regime Change In Birthland
item.description: RFE/RL’s Ray Furlong visits a Persian spice market in Tel Aviv where Iranian Jewish shopkeepers and stallholders say they’re in a “strange” situation -- but hope that the war will bring political change in the land of their birth.

item.title: Trump On New Supreme Leader: 'We'll See What Happens'
item.description: As the US-Israeli war with Iran continues to impact and shape the region, journalists from RFE/RL deliver ongoing updates and analysis.

item.title: Magic Bullet? Sci-Fi Laser Weapons Are Now An Anti-Drone Reality
item.description: Futuristic laser weapons are now deployed with some militaries and are being demonstrated by Ukrainian startups. Industry insiders say the technology can counter the threat of cheap kamikaze drones, but there are significant caveats.

item.title: Iranian Jews In Israel Speak Of Pain And Hope Amid Conflict
item.description: There are an estimated 250,000 Iranian Jews in Israel, defined as Jews born in Iran plus second and third generations. RFE/RL's Ray Furlong speaks to several in Tel Aviv about their hopes and fears for change in Iran.

item.title: Wladimir Van Wilgenburg: Kurdish Groups Need US 'Guarantees' Before Iran Offensive
item.description: In an interview with RFE/RL, Wladimir van Wilgenburg said while there is significant noise about a Kurdish-led offensive into Iran from Iraqi Kurdistan, the Kurdish groups themselves are being deeply cautious and are currently in an "exploration phase.”

item.title: Then And Now: Life For Afghan Women Since The 2021 Taliban Takeover
item.description: For many Afghan women, especially those in conservative rural areas of the country, little has changed since the Taliban seized power in the country. For others, life under hard-line Islamist rule today looks vastly different from the two decades the country spent under US and NATO intervention.

item.title: Tehran Skyline Blanketed In Smoke Following Strikes On Oil Facilities
item.description: The Tehran skyline was filled with smoke following Israeli strikes on oil facilities in Iran. The Israeli military claimed responsibility for strikes on a number of fuel storage facilities in Tehran on March 8.

item.title: Israeli Opposition Head Says Wait And See On Any New Iranian Leader
item.description: Opposition leader Yair Lapid told RFE/RL in an interview in Tel Aviv that Israel reserves the right to target any leader chosen to head Iran after the Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in air strikes. Lapid said recent strikes on Iranian oil fields were needed to cut the “lifeline of the regime."

item.title: Israeli Opposition Leader Yair Lapid Tells RFE/RL Iran's Oil ‘Lifeline' Must Be Cut
item.description: Yair Lapid, the leader of the opposition in Israel, says air strikes on Iranian oil fields --which have showered Tehran in black rain -- were needed to cut the “lifeline of the regime” in Iran.

item.title: Iran Marks Mojtaba Khamenei Selection With Strikes Against Israel, Gulf States
item.description: Iran marked the first hours after the naming of Mojtaba Khamenei as supreme leader by launching missiles and drones at Israel and Gulf Arab states, who have begun expressing increasing anger over Tehran’s retaliatory strikes.
